resource.title: A Course in Graduate Algorithms（Bo Waggoner, CU Boulder CSCI 5454）讲义与视频
resource.covers: 16 讲完整讲义＋视频。第 6 讲 近似算法入门（近似比、顶点覆盖/集合覆盖/带权背包等），第 7 讲 在线算法入门（竞争比、ski rental、确定性下界），第 8 讲 随机化算法（期望/高概率保证、随机化舍入），第 10 讲 流算法（草图/摘要、heavy hitters）；另有 Word-RAM 与 Big-O、DFS/拓扑排序、最短路、DP、最大流最小割等基础模块。正对应节点的随机化保证、近似比、竞争分析与下界。

courses.prereq_text: CS 4820 or equivalent, i.e. an advanced undergraduate-level algorithms course. ... We will assume knowledge of: discrete mathematical structures, including graphs, trees, DAGs; basic data structures such as lists, trees, heaps, sorting and searching; asymptotic complexity, O( ) and o( ) notation, solving recurrences; machine models and general computability; algebra: linear algebra (including eigenvalues and eigenvectors); probability: sample spaces, random variables, expectation and variance, independence, conditional probability and expectation.

courses.course: CSCI 5454 Design and Analysis of Algorithms (课程讲义站)
courses.prereq_text: It is intended to also be accessible (with work) to students who are a bit rusty or never took undergrad algorithms but have programming and mathematics backgrounds.

extra_prereqs.evidence: Cornell CS 6820 的 'We will assume knowledge of' 列表含 discrete mathematical structures（graphs, trees, DAGs）与 solving recurrences。
同一列表含 'basic data structures such as lists, trees, heaps, sorting and searching'。
同一列表含 'linear algebra (including eigenvalues and eigenvectors)'。
同一列表含 'machine models and general computability'（可计算性基础）。

notes: 原图两个前置都有课程证据：Cornell CS 6820 明确要求 CS 4820（算法课，映射 F.1.2）并在假定知识里列出概率（M.6.1）。注意证据分歧：CU Boulder CSCI 5454 的讲义站自述 'intended to also be accessible ... to students who are a bit rusty or never took undergrad algorithms'，即该课不把算法课当硬性先修（记 unspecified，不是 contradicted，因为它没否认证价值）。资源选 bowaggoner（CU Boulder）而不是 CS 6820，原因：CS 6820 的 2016fa/2017fa 站点里 schedule.html 已经变成另一门课（CS 2110）的内容，讲义链接不可靠；bowaggoner 站的讲义与视频（Module 2 正是 approximation/online/randomized）目前完整可访问（已逐条打开核对目录）。CS 6820 页面本身仍可访问，仅用它作先修证据。
